title: SS28 Men's Knit Fabric Direction
summary: SS28 men's knits: open knits, crochet, cooling jersey and fine merino-silk.
research_period: SS28 previews published November 2025 to November 2026; SS27 runway record

sections.heading: How this forecast was built
sections.body: Long-range projection. SS28 fabric fairs open with Première Vision Paris on 26-28 January 2027, and the shows run from June to October 2027. This report projects from the first SS28 forecaster and fair previews, the SS27 runways and long-term market and regulatory drivers. Forecut will update it after the fairs and again after the shows.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- Milano Unica sees wool moving toward "ultra-fine qualities, airy surfaces and ultralight constructions"<sup>[1]</sup>
- Matte finishes ground dark colour, satin and gloss intensify it, and sheer fabrics and open knits lighten it; extreme heat is moving socialising into the evening<sup>[2]</sup>
- Everyday basics gain "integrated wellness properties" and materials that "intuitively adjust for temperature and activity"<sup>[3]</sup>
